title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT USSyniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐drivenTechnical Product Ownerto serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key Skills Visionary Leadership:Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication:Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action- Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT USSyniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐drivenTechnical Product Ownerto serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key Skills Visionary Leadership:Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication:Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action- Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners. Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados. Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas. Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos. Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.Qualificações Mínimas
- Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.

- Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente).

- Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados.
- Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.
- Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).
- Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados.
- Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.
- Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.
- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
- Inglês fluente.Qualificações Desejáveis

- Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning.
- Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots).
- Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA.
- Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence).
- Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Budget for English lessons.Why Join XILO? A great tech startup– Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth– Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing– Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCsKindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Location:RemoteType:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Confira esta oportunidade para Cloud Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and DevOps processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Primary Job Duties: Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time. Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work. Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues. Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision. Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design. Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures. Support DevOps practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues. Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices. Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings. Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis. Improve system reliability through automation and observability.Qualifications Required Qualifications:The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role. Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration. Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS. Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools. Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.G., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required. Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing.Desired Qualifications:The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role. Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.G., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity. AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Developer. Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems. Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly. Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position.This is a CLT role and not open to PJ. Compensation is R$9000-R$12000/month plus bonus

title: Customer Loyalty Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Loyalty Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered text and voice communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market.We're building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us?About you: This is a direct-hire role. As a Customer Loyalty Specialist, your primary responsibility is to reduce churn and protect revenue. You will proactively engage canceled and churned accounts via calls, text, and emails to understand why. Most importantly, you'll be the bridge that enables customer success, helping us retain them. As a result, retained revenue will follow with subscription renewals, of which you will be responsible for attaining a monthly quota.What You'll Own: Responsible for reducing churn by retaining customers and revenue. You'll own a monthly customer retention quota as your main KPI. Apply approved retention strategies (in-app credits, billing credits, plan downgrades, and success enablement) within defined guidelines. Intercept downgrade requests and reposition value through usage planning, campaign scheduling, and ROI alignment before the plan change is approved. Identify and recover failed onboarding cases by re-driving activation and time-to-first-value. Perform proactive outreach to low-usage and disengaged accounts using structured "silent churn" playbooks to re-engage customers before cancellation intent surfaces. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.What We're Looking For: 5+ years in a customer retention or account management role. 3+ years within a SaaS company. Conduct 50+ weekly retention calls via phone or Google Meet. Proven ability to analyze customer behavior, identify churn risks, and take targeted action to retain accounts. Strong objection handling, negotiation, and behavioral communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions under pressure. Ability to diagnose and act on different churn drivers (budget, usage, performance, lifecycle, compliance) with tailored retention strategies. Able to work efficiently in a high-activity environment without sacrificing quality. Comfortable holding long-format video calls for reviewing customer accounts and demonstrating product value. Coachable, performance-driven, accountable, and a strong team player. Proficient or native level English (full business fluency). Work a minimum of 40 hours/week between 10 am and 7 pm EST, Monday to Friday. Bonus Points: Experience working at a CPaaS or Martech SaaS company. Experience working with real estate professionals.️ Why Smarter Contact? USD base compensation 15 days PTO + 5 sick days + 10 floating holidays (6 weeks off) High autonomy, fast execution, real impact Professional development benefit Wellness benefit Employment anniversary and birthday gift Quarterly health allowance Remote-first team with a strong performance culture This opportunity is offered as a full-time independent contractor rolePlease Don't Apply If: You prefer a low-pressure, low-output environment You're not fluent in English or are uncomfortable communicating directly with cross-functional teams You don't meet the minimum customer success experience No experience working for a SaaS companyReady to grow with us? We're looking for a proven Customer Loyalty Specialist ready to build the next chapter of their career — and stay for the long haul. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.Why Hoist? You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\ "does this surface the right principal investigator?\ ") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you're proud of.Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai Evaluation Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About FirstIgniteFirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production. The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company. What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\ "does this surface the right principal investigator?\ ") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests. Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results. Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs. Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy. As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you're proud of. Please email the video to with the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent Acquisition Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Talent Acquisition Specialist About Us: We are a dynamic global specialist in talent research, intelligence, and pipelining. Since its founding in 2011, it's grown to serve internal talent acquisition teams—including more than 70 Fortune 500 companies —through offices spanning the UK, US, India, Singapore, Dubai, Hong Kong, and beyond. We blend data-driven insight and proactive sourcing to streamline recruitment, delivering seamless access to ready now candidates and curated pipelines for future roles. Its recent acquisition of Armstrong Craven further strengthens our global reach and research capabilities, offering clients unmatched flexibility and depth in talent solutionsThe Role: We have partnered with a global FMCG powerhouse which has a reputation for innovation and development. As part of this contract we are looking for a passionate Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist. If you're excited by new challenges, solving complex problems, and learning every step of the way, you might be the perfect fit. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to drive impactful projects and collaborate with bright minds.What You'll Do: Manage autonomously the different talent acquisition solutions to source, engage, attract, and secure the right talent for the organization within a highly scientific environment Partner with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, execute effective sourcing, engagement, screening, and behavioural-based interviews that deliver a diverse range of candidates and provide an outstanding candidate experience Possess strong ability to screen, assess, interview, and build relationships within different talent communities in a timely and professional manner Build and maintain market intelligence and a network of talent and potential candidates through previous experience, pro-active research, and ongoing relationships;
conduct in-depth interviews of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate manager requirements through high interview-to-offer ratios Display confidence to work with metrics and reporting to establish recruitment updates and insight to ensure hiring is effective and can clearly demonstrate successes versus areas of focus Generate and recommend ideas and strategies related to recruitment that will contribute to the enhancement of hiring processes, implementing changes and new procedures, and fine-tuning standard recruiting processes that fit within the client's mission Contribute to or lead projects designed to implement change initiatives and enhance delivery Articulate in writing a plan with deliverables, timelines, formal tracking, and reporting results Promote continuous improvement of talent acquisition methods and processesWhat we are looking for: Passion for talent acquisition with an extensive track record of recruiting hard to fill roles Expert understanding of talent networks and recruitment landscapes in Brazil and South America Ability to execute sourcing activities, including but not limited to employer brand promotion, talent engagement and attraction, supporting events and meet-ups, and quality candidate pipeline generation with a significant proportion of direct and passive sourcingWho You Are: Someone who is not satisfied with "just good enough" and is always looking to improve, adapt, and innovate A natural collaborator who loves sharing ideas and learning from others Excellent communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to share complex ideas in a simple, relatable way Fluent in English and PortugueseAre You Still Curious? If you've read this far, then chances are you've got a curious mind—just like us. So, what are you waiting for? Take the leap and apply today. We can't wait to see where your curiosity leads you—and how it will shape the future of the client.

Sobre a VolpiSomos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando aevolução do financiamento imobiliário. Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiênciasinteligentes, simples e digitais. Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!O desafio Buscamos umSenior Data Engineerpara liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base. Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio. Aqui, você teráalto nível de autonomia e ownership, tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.O que você vai fazer: Desenhar, implementar e evoluir aarquitetura de dados da Volpi, com foco em um modelo delakehousena AWS;
Estruturar pipelines deingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos desegurança, governança e compliance;
Lidar comdados distribuídos em múltiplos silos, conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base paraprodutos de dados futuros, incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.O que esperamos de você: Experiência sólida comoData Engineer, com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
Domínio de Python e SQLpara construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
Experiência prática comAWS, especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
Conhecimento e uso deInfraestrutura como Código (IaC);
Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação comsegurança da informação, padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;

Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.Será considerado um diferencial: Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);

Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.Benefícios que oferecemos: Modelo remoto prioritário Plano de saúde Alice (100% pago para titular e dependentes) R$600/ano para infraestrutura de home office R$1.000/ano de auxílio educação 30 dias de descanso remunerado + 10 dias de recesso de fim de ano Day off no aniversário TotalPass (incluindo TotalMind) Acesso ao Wework Encontros presenciais para troca e conexão com a nossa Tribo

title: Médico Oncologista Genético

Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOSFormação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE(Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);
Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.Local de Trabalho: REMOTORemuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.IMPORTANTE:MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Oncologista.

O foco será a construção de ecossistemas inteligentes, indo além de modelos isolados para criar arquiteturas de agentes capazes de resolver demandas complexas de negócio e backoffice.O DESAFIO:Orquestração e Agentes:Projetar sistemas multiagentes utilizandoLangGraphouAgent Squadpara decompor tarefas complexas em workflows automatizados. Observabilidade e Tracing (Prioridade):Implementar o rastreamento completo da\ "cadeia de pensamento\" (Chain of Thought) e execução dos agentes. AI Guardrails:Implementar camadas de filtragem e validação de prompts/outputs para evitar injeções de código ou desvios éticos. Avaliação Sistemática:Desenvolver frameworks de testes (Evals) para validar a eficácia de novas funcionalidades antes do deploy em produção. Eficiência de Custos:Monitorar e otimizar o uso de modelos (Model Routing) para equilibrar performance e custo operacional.O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:Linguagens:Domínio avançado dePythoneJavapara automação de workflows e integraçoes e desenvolvimento de IA. DevOps/MLOps:Experiência comDocker,Containerizatione práticas de CI/CD para modelos de linguagem. Educação:Graduação em Engenharia de Computação ou áreas correlatas.VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:Experiência prévia na construção de assistentes inteligentes escaláveis (ex: via WhatsApp) e pesquisa emExplainable AI (XAI).O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível) Assistência Médica Assistência Odontológica Einstein Conecta: Orientação médica online com os especialistas do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito. ️ Seguro de Vida: Segurança para você e quem você ama. Auxílio Creche: Para ajudar nas despesas dos pequenos Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida: Mais tempo para aproveitar os momentos especiais. Previdência Privada: Planeje o futuro com segurança. Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): Sucesso compartilhado com todos. Fretado das estações Barra Funda e Santana Gympass: Acesso a academias e atividades físicas para manter a saúde em dia. Reset Day: 1 dia OFF por ano para aproveitar da melhor forma. Plano Petlove: um cuidado especial para os companheiros de home office Plataforma Onhappy: Benefícios e facilidades para suas viagens e momentos de lazerPor que escolher a Dimensa?Na Dimensa, você fará parte de um time que está revolucionando o mercado de operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros, com inovação e tecnologia de ponta. Queremos conhecer você e ver como você pode contribuir para nossa missão! Junte-se a nós e faça a diferença.#VEMFAZERPARTEDAONDAVERDE

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Oncologista Genético em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. *OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\ " Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas emOncologia Genética!Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOSFormação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE(Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Machine Learning Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2B platform for hospitality. We're looking for aSenior Machine Learning Engineerwho is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially themathematical and statistical foundationsbehind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants togrow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a truetechnical championwithin the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us.What you'll do Design, train, and improvestatistical and machine learning modelsfor real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals inprobability, statistics, and modelingto make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Buildscalable ML solutionsthat can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to supportagent-like experienceswithin our platform (e.G., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.What we're looking for We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you. You'llbe successfulin this roleif you have: Strong knowledge across a broad range ofmachine learning algorithms(supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding instatistics and mathematical reasoning(e.G., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.G., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow). Nice to have (not required) Experience withNLP and/or LLMs(helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities onAWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.G., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integratingvector search / embedding-based retrieval.Why Join Us You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.Equal Opportunity Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

description:

Senior Writer (Roteirista)Location:Remote Position Type:Contract Company:Pocket FMAbout Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series.Role Overview As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.Key Responsibilities 1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization. Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy. Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks. Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons. 2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers. Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth. Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation. Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production. 3. Team Management & Leadership Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows. Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team. Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team. Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact. 4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion. Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements. Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback. Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth. 5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output. Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content. Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output. 6. User-Centric Content Improvement Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches. Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges. Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement. 7. Stakeholder Collaboration Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets. Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans. Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders. 8. Promotion & Growth Strategy Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows. Ensure promos align with the show's narrative hook and audience appeal. description:

Essa posição será responsável por conduzir projetos de onboarding com diferentes níveis de complexidade, garantindo organização, cumprimento de prazos e qualidade na entrega, mesmo em cenários fora do fluxo padrão. Estruturar e gerenciar cronogramas de implantação, acompanhando entregas, dependências e riscos ao longo da jornada;

Conduzir reuniões de projeto (kickoff, checkpoints, treinamentos e follow-ups), assegurando evolução do cliente ao longo da jornada;
Gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, mantendo organização e priorização das demandas;
Identificar riscos, desvios e oportunidades de melhoria durante a execução, propondo planos de ação;
Monitorar indicadores de sucesso como adoção, engajamento e satisfação do cliente;
Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas internas (Produto, Suporte, Comercial), garantindo fluidez nas entregas;
Garantir registros e acompanhamento estruturado das interações e demandas dos clientes;
Contribuir com melhorias de processos, trazendo visão crítica e sugestões baseadas na operação.O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ: Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Onboarding ou Atendimento ao Cliente B2B;
Vivência prática com gestão de projetos (planejamento, execução e acompanhamento de cronogramas);
Experiência com múltiplos stakeholders e condução de agendas estruturadas;
Capacidade de organização e gestão de múltiplas demandas simultâneas;
Boa leitura de indicadores e acompanhamento de performance do cliente;
Conhecimento intermediário em ferramentas como GSuite ou Pacote Office. Comunicação executiva e influência;
Organização e capacidade de priorização;
Protagonismo e senso dedono;
Escuta ativa e construção de relacionamento;
Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica;
Maturidade para atuaçãoem cenários de pressão e negociação;
Boa gestão de relacionamento com clientes e áreas internas.INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média. E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente. Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma. ● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria... ● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

title: Senior Writer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Writer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Writer (Roteirista)Location:Remote Position Type:Contract Company:Pocket FMAbout Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a strategic and creative Senior Writer to lead content development, drive show performance, and manage a team of writers across multiple audio series.Role Overview As a Senior Writer, you will be the end-to-end owner of multiple shows, responsible for their creative direction, content quality, and audience performance. You will lead a team of Junior Writers, oversee localization and adaptation workflows, and ensure that each show delivers strong engagement and retention. This role requires a blend of storytelling expertise, analytical thinking, and leadership to continuously optimize content from a user-first perspective.Key Responsibilities 1. Show Ownership & Editorial Strategy Own multiple shows end-to-end, from pre-editorial planning to post-release optimization. Define show-level creative direction, narrative arcs, and long-term storytelling strategy. Review and approve concept notes, localization approaches, and adaptation frameworks. Ensure consistency in tone, character development, and narrative quality across episodes and seasons. 2. Content Development & Adaptation Oversight Oversee script adaptation and localization workflows executed by Junior Writers. Ensure all scripts meet editorial standards, cultural relevance, and storytelling depth. Guide the use of GenAI tools for structured, high-quality script adaptation. Provide detailed feedback and direction to refine scripts before production. 3. Team Management & Leadership Manage and mentor a team of Junior Writers, each assigned to individual shows. Review outputs, provide constructive feedback, and ensure consistent quality across the team. Drive accountability, productivity, and skill development within the team. Foster a strong creative culture focused on storytelling excellence and user impact. 4. Performance Monitoring & Optimization Track and analyze show performance using key metrics such as user retention, listen duration, and conversion. Identify underperforming episodes, story arcs, or shows and implement data-driven improvements. Plan and execute show reworks based on audience behavior and feedback. Continuously optimize content to maximize engagement and platform growth. 5. Production Collaboration & Quality Control Provide feedback on voice-over, production quality, and final audio output. Ensure alignment between scripts and produced audio content. Collaborate with production, QC, and creative teams to maintain high-quality output. 6. User-Centric Content Improvement Analyze user feedback, comments, and listening patterns to refine storytelling approaches. Apply a strong user-first lens to identify gaps and solve content-related challenges. Ensure content resonates with target audiences and drives long-term engagement. 7. Stakeholder Collaboration Work closely with business, content, and production teams to align on show goals and performance targets. Participate in weekly reviews with the business team to evaluate show progress and define action plans. Communicate insights, risks, and opportunities effectively across stakeholders. 8. Promotion & Growth Strategy Guide the development of promotional concepts and scripts for assigned shows. Ensure promos align with the show's narrative hook and audience appeal. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, or a related field. Proven experience in scriptwriting, content localization, or storytelling for audio/video platforms. Strong leadership experience managing writers or creative teams. Deep understanding of narrative structure, pacing, and audience engagement strategies. Experience working with AI-based writing/adaptation tools is preferred. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret performance data and drive decisions. Excellent communication, feedback, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple shows and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.Key Traits for Success Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability for show performance Ability to think from a user perspective and solve content challenges creatively Leadership and mentoring capability to build high-performing writing teams Understanding and crafting the workflow as new challenges arise Balance of creativity and data-driven decision-making
