Garantirqualidade, governança e confiabilidade dos dados, promovendo boas práticas analíticas no time.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Machine Learning Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‐generation AI‐native B2B platform for hospitality. We're looking for aSenior Machine Learning Engineerwho is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially themathematical and statistical foundationsbehind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you're someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you'll feel at home here. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants togrow into a future architect, help define large-scale backend systems, and become a truetechnical championwithin the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you'll love working with us.What you'll do Design, train, and improvestatistical and machine learning modelsfor real product use cases. Apply strong fundamentals inprobability, statistics, and modelingto make sound decisions on approach and evaluation. Buildscalable ML solutionsthat can be used reliably in production environments. Develop capabilities to supportagent-like experienceswithin our platform (e.G., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails). Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.What we're looking for We're intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you're strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we'd love to hear from you. You'llbe successfulin this roleif you have: Strong knowledge across a broad range ofmachine learning algorithms(supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately. Solid grounding instatistics and mathematical reasoning(e.G., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design). Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration. Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code. Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.G., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow). Nice to have (not required) Experience withNLP and/or LLMs(helpful, but not a core requirement). Exposure to ML-related capabilities onAWS, such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.G., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML. Experience implementing or integratingvector search / embedding-based retrieval.Why Join Us You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You'll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.Equal Opportunity Directful is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus). Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation. Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture. Energetic self-starter who can work in a complex, collaborative environment that rewards innovation, initiative, curiosity, and mentoring. Knowledge of sports and gaming.

qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde emcardiologia.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a contínuo.Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos title: Technical Business Analyst – Fix Protocol / Trading Applications
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Business Analyst – Fix Protocol / Trading Applications em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Technical Business Analyst – FIX Protocol / Trading Applications We are looking for aTechnical Business Analystwith strong experience inFIX Protocolandtrading applicationsto support technology initiatives within a global financial services environment. This role requires a professional who can work closely with business stakeholders, product teams, application development teams and vendors to gather, analyze, document and validate business and technical requirements for trading-related systems. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working withSQL queries, UNIX log analysis, functional specifications, data flows, system integrations and UAT support. Key responsibilities Gather, analyze and document business, functional and technical requirements for trading applications. Work closely with business stakeholders, developers, vendors and product teams to define and validate technology solutions. Create and maintain functional specifications, business rules, exception rules and process documentation. Analyze system data across multiple platforms, includingUNIX, FIX, Oracle, SQL Server and mainframe environments. Perform SQL queries and UNIX log analysis to support requirements definition, issue investigation and validation. Translate business needs into clear technical requirements for development teams. Support data sourcing activities, validating data completeness from acquisition through report or system delivery. Define and support testing requirements, test cases and UAT activities. Conduct functional walkthroughs and obtain business sign-off. Track project risks, defects, change requests and delivery status. Support multiple projects or workstreams in parallel within the software development lifecycle. Required experience 5+ years of experience as aBusiness AnalystorTechnical Business Analyst. Strong experience withFIX Protocol. Experience working withtrading applicationsor capital markets platforms. Hands-on experience withSQL queries. Experience withUNIX log analysis. Ability to write clear functional and technical requirements. Experience creatingFSDs, business requirements, test cases and UAT documentation. Good understanding of system integrations, data flows and application troubleshooting. Ability to translate technical concepts to business stakeholders and business requirements to technical teams. Experience working with developers, vendors, product managers and business SMEs. Advanced English for communication with global teams. Nice to have Experience in financial services, brokerage, investment banking, wealth management or capital markets. Knowledge of Oracle, SQL Server or mainframe environments. Experience with data governance standards. Experience leading small projects or coordinating workstreams. Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models. Ideal profile The ideal candidate is not a purely functional BA. We are looking for ahands-on Technical Business Analystwho understands trading systems, can analyze FIX messages, read UNIX logs, write SQL queries, document requirements clearly and work directly with both business and technology teams.
